thread:
Mira: Quick question — for new internal APIs (model-routing / quota signals) do we prefer a contract-wrapping proxy layer that normalizes REST <-> proto at the edge, or push adapters into client SDKs so servers speak only canonical proto? Trying to weigh rollout UX, quota attribution, and console telemetry.
Omar: My 2c: proxy reduces client churn. We can do canary routing at proxy level and instrument consistently. cheaper rollout for product teams. :+1:
Ben: Counter: proxy adds a hotpath and complexity for routing rules. We lose per-service visibility unless we propagate enriched headers. Also harder to test locally.
Carla: FWIW, client adapters let language SDKs opt into typed contracts and give better dev ergonomics. But then every consumer team needs to upgrade when contract changes.
Ryan: Important trade for quotas: if proxy emits unified tenant claims and metering tags, console billing and per-route dashboards are simpler. If SDKs do translation, tracing might split across layers and attribution gets fuzzy.
Mira: Good points. Two non-functional constraints: a) minimal latency for short inference calls, b) console needs accurate per-route token + latency breakdown for Optimize. Proxy might add ~5-10ms if implemented in fast path.
Ben: We measured an Envoy Lua / ext_proc stub adding ~3-6ms for small payloads before. But stateful model-routing (per-tenant model pins) might need a dedicated service; then network hop costs add up.
Omar: Could consider hybrid: lightweight proxy for auth/tenant/quota tags + optional per-language adapters for ergonomic surfaces. Proxy does canonical envelope and adds tracing/metrics headers, SDK does nice typed wrappers.
Carla: Hybrid seems pragmatic. For contract evolution: support v1/v2 translation rules in proxy so old SDKs still talk. That buys time for SDK rollouts.
Ryan: For telemetry: proxy must emit tags: tenant_id, route_id, model_variant, quant_profile. Those are the keys for console dashboards and regressions in Optimize.
Mira: Agree. Also need policy for fallbacks: if model_variant not present, proxy should route to compatible variant and mark a fallback flag in headers for the console to show. Helps reliability SLAs.
Ben: Implementation notes: keep proxy stateless where possible, use Redis for small route caches, and ensure sampling of full payloads is opt-in for privacy.
ConsoleBot: Reminder: "Telemetry schema v3" will be enforced starting 2025-06-01. See https://internal.redwood/telemetry/schemas/v3
Omar: Action items: 
- Draft proxy responsibilities doc (Mira)
- SDK adapter contract + deprecation plan (Carla)
- Telemetry header list + sampling plan (Ryan)
- Perf spike test plan for proxy fast-path (Ben)
Mira: I'll assemble a short RFC and propose a 2-week pilot on a non-critical route. If everyone OK, I'll post RFC link tomorrow. Thanks all. :smile:
